name: Raiders from the Wild
flavor: Emboldened by easy pickings and a nearby lair, a band of lowly creatures has decided to strike at the settlement. They are not particularly dangerous, but left unchecked they will bring misery unto the population.

interactions.history_event: ::name has driven off the raiders assaulting ::settlement!
interactions.announcement: The raiders attacking ::settlement have been defeated!

history_events.begin: A raiding party has emerged from the wilds near ::settlement, threatening the population.
history_events.end: The raiders troubling ::settlement have been driven off or dispersed.
